from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,tempfile,shutil,json
root=Path.cwd();work=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='cli-error-red-',dir=os.environ['TMPDIR']))
try:
 pack=work/'pack';pack.mkdir();consumer=work/'consumer';consumer.mkdir()
 subprocess.run(['node','scripts/package-payload/CheckPackagePayload.ts','--pack-destination',str(pack)],check=True,timeout=60)
 subprocess.run(['npm','init','-y'],cwd=consumer,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True,timeout=30)
 subprocess.run(['npm','install','--ignore-scripts','--no-audit','--no-fund','--fetch-retries=0','--fetch-timeout=15000',str(next(pack.glob('*.tgz')))],cwd=consumer,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True,timeout=60)
 package=consumer/'node_modules/@git-stunts/git-warp'
 preload=consumer/'inject-failure.mjs'
 source="import {CasError} from '@git-stunts/git-cas';import {COMMANDS} from "+json.dumps((package/'dist/bin/cli/commands/registry.js').as_uri())+";import {CliError} from "+json.dumps((package/'dist/bin/cli/infrastructure.js').as_uri())+";COMMANDS.set('failure-fixture',async()=>{const batch=new CasError('Batch object count 1001 exceeds maximum 1000','PAGE_BATCH_LIMIT');const retention=new CasError('Workspace staged a batch but could not establish retention','WORKSPACE_RETENTION_FAILED',{originalError:batch,privateCredential:'DO_NOT_DISCLOSE'});if(process.env.FAILURE_CASE==='metadata')throw retention;return {human:'START',completion:Promise.reject(new CliError('Primary command failed',{code:'E_USAGE',exitCode:1,cause:retention})),close:async()=>{throw new Error('Secondary cleanup failed');}};});"
 preload.write_text(source)
 failures=[]
 for scenario in ['metadata','aggregate-cleanup']:
  for mode in ['human','json','jsonl']:
   env=os.environ.copy();env['NODE_OPTIONS']='--import='+str(preload);env['FAILURE_CASE']=scenario
   arguments=[] if mode=='human' else ['--'+mode]
   r=subprocess.run(['node',str(package/'bin/git-warp'),'failure-fixture',*arguments],cwd=consumer,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
   print('ACTUAL_INSTALLED_CLI_FAILURE',scenario,mode,'exit',r.returncode,'stdout',repr(r.stdout),'stderr',repr(r.stderr),flush=True)
   emitted=r.stdout+r.stderr
   assert 'DO_NOT_DISCLOSE' not in emitted
   if 'PAGE_BATCH_LIMIT' not in emitted or '1001' not in emitted:failures.append(scenario+':'+mode+':nested-code-missing')
   if scenario=='aggregate-cleanup' and ('E_USAGE' not in emitted or 'Secondary cleanup failed' not in emitted):failures.append(scenario+':'+mode+':primary-or-cleanup-missing')
 print('NESTED_CLI_ACCEPTANCE_FAILURES',failures,flush=True)
 if failures:raise SystemExit(1)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(work)
